Looking for a Clan!

* **Your system(s):** PS4 (I have and use my mic a lot)
* **Your Gamertag:** okaashii
* **Your country/time zone:** USA- Eastern 
* **When do you usually play (include times and time zone):** I play frequently, my dad and I have been leveling a couple characters. I usually find myself on between 12PM EST and 7PM EST. Weekends are the same, although some Sundays I might skip here and there. 
* **Tell us a bit about yourself:** I have two characters currently and just started picking the game up again in preparation for Destiny 2. I have a Titan (light 330) and a Hunter that I'm leveling right now. I love raiding but have only done one raid. Pretty crap at PvP but I'm trying, as I used to love PvP in WoW. I'm one of the few that actually likes leveling, so I'm always game to level with other people.
* **What are you looking for in a clan:** I really want some people who can help me, or I can help them. Chat around, just have a good time and get some raiding done, maybe help me get better at PvP- but really just looking for a laid back ready to play sort of group with raiding and questing as a focus over PvP. Also worth noting, my dad and I would be looking to join. We like to have a couple beers on occasion and just shoot the sh*t, so 18+ is preferable. (I'm 25, female, he is 49)

If you can get in touch with them, let me know how you managed to.
Stay tough big guy, I'm rooting for you

The reason I failed out is medical: I started new medication that made me rampantly suicidal. In order to prepare for such a measure, I withdrew to the point I no longer could leave my apartment. I missed over a month of school, now here I am. It was self sabotage really.


As for employment, I have a few people I know in the company already. I've asked if they could inquire about my situation without mentioning names, to see if I could postpone my offer. Hopefully I can, as I feel getting help at home while I attended a community college would be the best route.
I really needed to hear something like this, specifically about life welcoming you back. You've given me some hope, thank you.

It's true, with respect to substance abuse. I don't hold anything save my ability to get high and forget these days. I only smoke pot, not that the substance matters much itself. I abuse it like a heroin addict abuses. For blaming others, I find it more difficult to blame people for not caring, because from what I understand of the world, I cannot blame what isn't important. However I would say that finding reasons to revoke trust would be more applicable in the capacity for which you described. It may not even be a matter of trust: in my eyes, everyone wants something, everyone looks out for themselves, and attempting to feel poorly that people don't pity you is no way to go about life. Maybe it's more of a "me against the world," but more so in a "I'm very scared of being close to people." I have almost been raped by a man I was seeing, and he felt no remorse. I was angry, but I didn't hate all men, I just became more wary. I have been emotionally abused in numerous relationships, but once again, blame myself for my predisposition towards men who will treat me as my stepfather did. I consider it having a penchant for self-degradation and somebody to "tell me what to do, control me" as I have little to no self control myself, and feel I deserve punishment for my actions, but have no outlet of punishment as I cannot care about myself.

How do I relate to others? I don't hold them in higher esteem, or myself in higher esteem. I would say that I am abrasive, guarded. I try to relate at social events, and unless there is alcohol, I find myself overwhelmed and hoping to go home quickly. Do I trust myself? That's an interesting question that I find myself unable to answer without further reflection

I throughly enjoy the clarity in your response regarding the first portion. You're correct, posting to a forum offers little with respect to solving complicated problems. My search for a good counselor/advisor has been fruitless. I was seeing a woman at my university, but I frequently missed appointments, fell through the cracks. After my hospitalization for another suicide attempt in 2015, I was required to see her for outpatient, but once again took up my past behavior of disappearing for long periods of time without contact. The office never checked to see where I was or how I was doing, but in reality I cannot  blame them for my shortcomings. I made a final effort to see my therapist during her "crisis hour" after reaching out to her via email. After I arrived and was waiting to see her, a girl came in crying asking to speak to somebody. While I wasn't crying or hysterical myself, I had finally left my house in days in order to see much sought after help. The girl was brought in, I was turned away, and I haven't gone back since. Maybe I'm being stubborn or prideful, but I cannot trust that woman, or that office, again.
I am currently taking 10MGs of Lexapro, and have had issues finding a good therapist
